subject: business-studies

moments.title: Three-Dimensional CSR Model
moments.body: Carroll's framework distinguishes economic, legal, ethical and discretionary responsibilities of business.
moments.takeaway: CSR could be analysed as layered responsibilities.

moments.title: Pyramid of CSR
moments.body: Carroll arranges the four CSR domains into a pyramid model that becomes a standard teaching framework.
moments.takeaway: A visual model spread CSR rapidly into business education.

moments.title: Triple Bottom Line
moments.body: Elkington coins 'triple bottom line' (people, planet, profit), framing sustainable business reporting.
moments.takeaway: Sustainability acquired its own accounting language.

now.title: CSR to ESG
now.body: ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) frameworks have largely displaced CSR in financial markets and corporate reporting.
now.open_questions: Does ESG integration change corporate behaviour or only disclosure?

reflection: Carroll's pyramid is taught everywhere; Elkington has since 'recalled' the triple bottom line as inadequate.
